topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Rain's been falling all damn night, puddling on the streets, soaking into the cracks in the city. Got a call from an artist, says someone’s been inking her designs into flesh. Not a job I ever wanted, trailing after some two-bit tattoo artist who thinks he's doing the city a favor. But the way she described it, the desperation in her voice, it was hard to say no. She’s got nothing left, just these designs. I told her I'd look into it, even though I know it’s like chasing shadows. This city swallows people and their stories whole. I just hope maybe this time, it'll spit out a little truth.
